contexts.text: The purchase of money () = the spiritual. AC 2052. AC 2101. AC 2114.
To buy, in the spiritual sense = to redeem. The spiritual are said to be bought with silver, that is, to be redeemed with truth. AC 2964.
Buy without money ()... To buy = to procure for themselves.
Purchase () = those things which have been acquired from another source.
To buy () = to appropriate to himself.
Acquisition, and purchase () = truths... Purchase, which is elsewhere called the purchase of silver, = truth.
Potiphar bought him... To buy = that he ascribed these things to himself.

To buy () = to procure for themselves, thus to appropriate. Spiritual procuring and appropriation are effected by means of good and truth; to this correspond the procuring and appropriation which are effected in the world by means of silver and gold... Hence buying = appropriation. Illustrated. AC 5406. AC 5410. AC 5426.
The sons of Israel came to buy in the midst of those who came () = that he willed spiritual truths to be procured by means of scientifics equally as the rest... To buy = to procure.
To buy gold () = to procure and appropriate to themselves good. AR 211. AE 242.
Thy servants are come to buy food () = that these truths are to be appropriated to the Natural by means of good... To buy = to be appropriated.
To buy with silver = to procure for one's self from what is one's own.

Return ye, buy us a little food () = that in order for them to live, they should procure for themselves the good of spiritual truth. To buy = to procure and appropriate. AC 5588. AC 5655, AC 5820. AC 5886:4, Illustrated.
Under Sell, see this reference.

For the provision which they bought () = that they should be supported by (the truth of the Church). To buy = to appropriate, and hence to be supported, because spiritual food is being treated of... which when appropriated, supports spiritual life.
Buy us and our ground for bread () = the appropriation of both, in order that they may be supported with good. To buy = appropriation.

Joseph bought the whole land of Egypt for Pharaoh () = that he appropriated to himself the whole natural mind where scientifics are, and placed it under the general auspices... in the Natural. AC 6153.

Only the ground of the priests bought he not () = that the Internal from the Natural procured for itself the capacities of receiving good... Not to buy = not to appropriate to itself these capacities...
Which Abraham bought () = redemption. To buy = to appropriate, thus also to redeem, for that which is redeemed is appropriated. AC 6461. AC 6549.
The purchase of silver () = which has any spiritual truth. Purchase = acquisition and appropriation.
To buy wine and milk without price = to procure for themselves the truth and good of faith from the Lord; thus gratis. AE 376:4. AE 617:10.
When thou buyest a Hebrew servant ()... To buy = to procure for one's self and appropriate. References.
They who are bought with silver = those who have been converted.
To buy () = to procure for themselves.
To buy and sell () = to procure for themselves Knowledges... AR 606:end. AE 840.
Bought from the earth () = those who can be regenerated by the Lord, and thus redeemed in the world.
(Spirits infusing a desire to buy certain things). SE 1333. SE 2169. SE 2954.
No buyer () = that they are utterly vile.

Bought from the earth = those who, having been instructed, received [truths] in the world. The bought, or redeemed of the Lord, = those who receive instruction from the Word, especially concerning the Lord. AE 860:2, Explained.
Not to buy any more () = to receive no more...
